headline: Pakistan Recommends Importing 800,000 Metric Tonnes of Wheat for Reserves
summary: A Pakistani cabinet committee chaired by Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar recommended importing up to 800,000 metric tonnes of wheat to build buffer stocks and stabilize domestic food staple prices.
why: Grain imports directly impact Pakistan's agricultural balance of payments and domestic food inflation figures.

impacts.name: Wheat
impacts.why: Pakistan's recommendation to import 800,000 metric tonnes of wheat introduces fresh sovereign demand.
